asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Call `props()` to spread the part's props, passing your own to merge them rather than overwrite them.
The state arrives as an accessor:
`render={(props, state) => <button {...props({ onClick: mine })}>{state().open}</button>}`

alignItemWithTrigger.description:
Whether the positioner overlaps the trigger so the selected item's text is
aligned with the trigger's value text. Only applies to mouse/keyboard input
and is automatically disabled for touch or when there is not enough space.

asChild.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

autoComplete.description: The autocomplete attribute for the hidden select. Enables browser autofill (e.g. "address-level1" for state).

closeOnSelect.description: Whether the select should close after an item is selected

defaultHighlightedValue.description:
The initial value of the highlighted item when opened.
Use when you don't need to control the highlighted value of the select.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the select's open state is controlled by the user

defaultValue.description:
The initial default value of the select when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the select.

deselectable.description:
Whether the value can be cleared by clicking the selected item.

**Note:** this is only applicable for single selection

form.description: The associate form of the underlying select.

highlightedValue.description: The controlled key of the highlighted item

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

ids.type:
Partial<{
  root: string
  content: string
  list: string
  control: string
  trigger: string
  clearTrigger: string
  label: string
  hiddenSelect: string
  positioner: string
  item: (id: string | number) => string
  itemGroup: (id: string | number) => string
  itemGroupLabel: (id: string | number) => string
}>
ids.description: The ids of the elements in the select. Useful for composition.

immediate.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

initialFocusEl.description:
Element to receive focus when the select is opened. Defaults to the first
tabbable element inside the content (typically the list).

loopFocus.description: Whether to loop the keyboard navigation through the options

name.description: The `name` attribute of the underlying select.

onEnterComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the open state

onExitComplete.description: Function called when the animation ends in the closed state

onFocusOutside.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

onHighlightChange.description: The callback fired when the highlighted item changes.

onInteractOutside.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

onOpenChange.description: Function called when the popup is opened

onPointerDownOutside.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

onSelect.description: Function called when an item is selected

onValueChange.description: The callback fired when the selected item changes.

open.description: Whether the select menu is open

popupType.description:
The ARIA pattern of the popup. Drives `aria-haspopup` on the trigger and
the `role` of the content element.
- `"listbox"` (default) — content is a passthrough wrapper; the list bears `role="listbox"`.
- `"dialog"` — content is announced as a dialog; useful when composing search inputs, tabs, or other widgets inside the popup.

positioning.description: The positioning options of the menu.

present.description: Whether the node is present (controlled by the user)

value.description: The controlled keys of the selected items
